title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees Payment Terms: Applying Payments and Installment Plans (Earlier Text with Retired Clause Marked)
content:
**Applying payments.** Fees of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** are paid by the methods the activity type accepts and are applied to the participation's oldest open fee first; a payment never moves to another participation or a sibling.

**Installment plan (earlier text, clause retired).**

> When the type offers the installment plan and the participation's fees net of credits total at least the installment threshold, the family may pay in the type's number of equal monthly installments, the first due before clearance and each later one on the same day of the following months; each installment is the net total divided by the number of installments rounded down to the cent, and the last installment carries the remaining cents.

This clause is **no longer in force** in this form. The current basis:

- for a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the first installment of the plan is set by the Fine Arts first installment schedule and is paid by the parent or guardian themselves online;
- every other participation keeps the standing plan, under which, when the type offers the installment plan and the participation's fees net of credits total at least the installment threshold, the family may pay in the type's number of equal monthly installments, the first due before clearance and each later one on the same day of the following months, each installment being the net total divided by the number of installments rounded down to the cent and the last installment carrying the remaining cents.

*Standing plan illustrated (hypothetical net total of 200.00 over 3 installments):* 200.00 divided by 3 is 66.666..., rounded down to 66.66; the installments are 66.66, 66.66 and 66.68, the last carrying the remaining 2 cents.

**Overdue installment.** A student whose installment is more than the type's fee due days overdue may not travel or perform until it is paid, but stays on the roster.

| Days an installment is overdue (fee due days of 14) | Effect of this rule | On the roster |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | not barred from travelling or performing by this rule | yes |
| 15 | may not travel or perform until it is paid | yes |

superseded_clauses: When installment_plan_available is true and the participation's fees net of credits total at least installment_threshold, the family may pay in installment_count equal monthly installments, the first due before clearance and each later one on the same day of the following months; each installment is the net total divided by installment_count rounded down to the cent, and the last installment carries the remaining cents.
